description: Search a New York City business address. Returns up to five verified address candidates with signed address tokens and current eligibility. Ask the customer to select the correct building when there is more than one candidate. An unverified address requires manual review and cannot be ordered. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry.

address.description: New York City street address, including the building number and street name.

borough.description: New York City borough containing the address; select one of the listed values.
